title: Months in a year
text: We need to enter the time of one year in months, which is $$12$$.

title: Plug in $$t=12$$.
text: Plug in $$t=12$$ to find the total credit card debt: $$1000(0.95)**{12}(1.18)**{12}.$$

title: Conclusion
text: Observe that in one year, with standard credit card interest rates and payment expectations, the debt is nearly $$4$$ times what it started as! You end up paying more in interest than the original debt in question.
